svg.title: 03 — Verified Worker Directory (1440px) | SevaKhata Website Master

g.text: Search and filter registered helpers. Each profile shows a transparent trust score, including how often their ledger entries are confirmed.
A 0–100 score built from four visible parts.
Awarded when the profile is marked verified with valid ID format.
Average rating out of 5 from previous employers, scaled to 30 points.
One point per year of verifiable experience, up to 10 points.
Share of reviewed ledger entries that helper confirmed without dispute.
Note: Ratings and verification in this milestone are sample data to demonstrate the interface. They are not real reviews or government checks.
Dono ka record, ek hi hisaab · The shared domestic employment ledger.
